user.title: Create Range Helper
user.description: Create a binary sensor that checks whether a numeric entity is inside or outside a defined range, with optional hysteresis and dynamic helper bounds.

data_description.source_entity: Select a numeric sensor (e.g., temperature, humidity, power, battery, illuminance) or input_number helper.
data_description.min_entity: Optional: Link an input_number or sensor to adjust the minimum limit dynamically.
data_description.max_entity: Optional: Link an input_number or sensor to adjust the maximum limit dynamically.
data_description.hysteresis: Deadband buffer added to bounds to prevent bouncing when values hover near limits.

error.empty_source: Please select a numeric target entity.
error.no_bounds_specified: Please specify at least one bound (minimum or maximum value or entity).
error.min_greater_than_max: The minimum value cannot be greater than the maximum value.
